statements.status_notes: An IN_PLACE sanitization hook that detaches an ancestor or an unvisited sibling can leave the detached subtree's event handlers executable. This requires the specific hook behavior and node-input mode described by the advisory. Their use in the OpenAPI UI remains unverified. The Open Liberty 26.0.0.11 OpenAPI UI bundle carries DOMPurify 3.4.16, while the upstream library fix is 3.4.17. Open Liberty 26.0.0.11 ships this code inside vendor-assembled bundles. Changing a standalone library dependency does not replace that bundled implementation; a compatible vendor release or validated bundle remediation and application-specific applicability assessment remain unresolved. A base-version scanner match alone does not establish exploitability. See https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-mrv2-3pqr-j5jr.

With SAFE_FOR_TEMPLATES and a DOM-returning or IN_PLACE mode, split template expressions can survive in an attached shadow root and later be evaluated by a template engine. The required input shape, output mode and downstream evaluator in the OpenAPI UI remain unverified. A base-version scanner match alone does not establish exploitability. See https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cg2g-xh64-v4q7.

DOMPurify XHTML parser mode can miss the case-sensitive SMIL attributeName=href guard. A configuration allowing SVG animate or set and attributeName can retain a javascript link that executes on a click. Default configurations and text/html mode are excluded. The OpenAPI UI sanitizer and SVG configuration remain unverified. The Open Liberty 26.0.0.11 OpenAPI UI bundle carries DOMPurify 3.4.16, while the upstream library fix is 3.4.17.
